items.desc:
✦ The Chosen One ✦

Among countless souls, only one bears the mark of destiny.

The Chosen One is not merely a title, but a symbol of an extraordinary fate. Its golden emblem is said to recognize the one destined to stand beyond all others. No crown can grant this honor, no throne can claim its power, and no amount of strength can force its awakening.

Some believe it is a blessing. Others call it a curse.

But one thing is certain: whoever possesses this card carries a title that was never meant for ordinary hands.

The stars have chosen. The world shall bear witness.

No one knows exactly when this card first appeared. Some say it was discovered among forgotten treasures, while others believe it has always been waiting for its rightful owner. Its golden mark seems to shine a little brighter in the hands of certain people. Perhaps it is just a coincidence... or perhaps the card has already made its choice.
